personality_one_liner: A calm, professional, and visually comfortable clinic management system that builds trust and streamlines daily dental operations.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythms. Content must breathe to avoid a dense, stressful dashboard look. Ensure safe area clearance on all scrollable views.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use glass on bottom sheet handles and headers.
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or standard cards.
Do not use glass if it impairs readability of Arabic text.

screens.name: Login (تسجيل الدخول)
screens.purpose: Secure multi-tenant login allowing doctors and assistants to sign in with specific role constraints.

states.error: Readable inline error message for incorrect credentials.

screens.layout: Minimalist single column. Clinic interior subtle background or clean solid background with large input fields, 'Forgot Password', and sticky bottom primary 'Login' CTA.

screens.name: Dashboard (لوحة القيادة)
screens.purpose: Daily operational snapshot showing today's appointments, queue, and financial charts.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for metrics and charts.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: Summary cards (Appointments, Revenue). Middle section: Interactive Profit/Loss charts. Bottom section: Today's queue list. Use a glass sticky header with the Clinic Logo.

screens.name: Patients & EHR (المرضى والملف الطبي)
screens.purpose: List of patients with search, leading to a detailed medical record (history, allergies, medications, X-rays).
screens.layout: Search bar sticky at top. List of patient cards. EHR Detail Screen uses tabs or segmented controls to divide 'Medical History', 'Dental Chart', 'X-Ray Gallery', and 'Invoices'. Export PDF sticky action at bottom.

screens.name: FDI Dental Chart (مخطط الأسنان)
screens.purpose: Interactive FDI (ISO 3950) tooth chart to record specific surface-level clinical findings.

states.empty: Fresh chart with all teeth healthy.
states.error: Failed to load chart state, retry button.

screens.layout: Top bar: patient name & arch selector. Center: Tappable 32-tooth odontogram shapes (not just buttons). Bottom sheet: When a tooth is tapped, pop up a sheet to select condition (caries, crown, extracted) with color codes.

screens.name: Appointments Calendar (التقويم)
screens.purpose: Visual timeline of upcoming appointments and automated reminders status.
screens.layout: Compact weekly calendar strip at top. Vertical timeline list below. Color-coded appointment chips based on status (confirmed, waiting, treated).

screens.name: Invoices & Billing (الفواتير)
screens.purpose: Digital invoice management (patients, purchases, expenses) with WhatsApp sharing.
screens.layout: Tabbed view (Patients, Expenses, Salaries). Detail view shows itemized invoice with a sticky bottom 'Share via WhatsApp' button using the brandPrimary color.

screens.name: Inventory & Lab (المستودع والمخبر)
screens.purpose: Track clinic supplies, low-stock alerts, and laboratory orders.
screens.layout: List of inventory items with visual low-stock indicators (warning color tags). Separate section for lab requests status tracking.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app MUST be fully RTL (Right-to-Left) compatible as it is in Arabic. Apply `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)` if configured globally, or utilize `flexDirection: 'row-reverse'` and appropriate text alignments (`textAlign: 'right'`) on all components.
Use 'Tajawal' from `@expo-google-fonts/tajawal` for all typography to ensure native Arabic typographic beauty.
Strictly adhere to the Sage/Slate color palette. DO NOT USE ANY BLUES OR PURPLES. These are banned. The UI should evoke a calm, medical trust feel.

For the FDI Dental Chart: Ensure you implement an interactive grid/list of 32 teeth (permanent) where each tooth acts as a tappable area, ideally using SVG shapes or highly styled React Native Views, not just standard buttons.
Dashboard and Financial charts: Render using a lightweight charting library like `react-native-chart-kit` or `react-native-gifted-charts`, styled with the provided 'brand' and 'success' tokens.
Use the `doctor_avatar` image for user profile placeholders, and `clinic_interior_background` with a heavy scrim/gradient (refer to <Imagery_and_Texture>) for the Login screen background.
Implement WhatsApp sharing for invoices using standard React Native `Linking.openURL('whatsapp://send?text=...')` or `Share.share()` API.
Multi-tenant logic: While mocking data, create separate initial views or toggles for 'Doctor' vs 'Assistant' to demonstrate role-based UI (e.g., hiding financial charts from assistants).
